_file: Baseline mode: embed and detect with nothing in between - does the model read back its own watermark, and what does embedding alone cost the audio? Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored. Reset with 'deepmark-benchmark --init no_attacks'.
_general: Operational settings; the matching CLI flag overrides each one. wav_files_dir has no default - set it here or pass --wav_files_dir. report_dir is DELETED at the start of every run. seed: integer for a repeatable run, or null for a fresh watermark per file.
_models: Model class names; several are put in one table, split into zero-bit and multi-bit sections. Any of: AudioSealModel, AwareModel, PerthModel, SilentCipherModel, TimbreWMModel, WavMarkModel. Each one's Docker service must be running.
_calculate_quality_metrics: Master switch: true = the metrics block below decides what runs; false or absent = only accuracy plus pesq, visqol, stoi, and the enabled flags are IGNORED (statistics still apply). Measuring the embedding cost is most of the point of this mode, so it is on.
_statistics: Default statistics per metric, and the report column order. Any of: mean, std, median, p5, p10, p95, p99, worst_case. Delete this key to get all eight.
_metrics: Per metric: enabled (true/false) and statistics (a subset of the list above). Metrics - accuracy (always on, cannot be disabled), ber, emr (a count, takes NO statistics), pesq, psnr, si_sdr, mcd, visqol, stoi, sii, ncm, nisqa_mos, nisqa_noi, nisqa_dis, nisqa_col, nisqa_loud. A metric named nowhere is off. Nothing is excluded here: embedding changes the signal without changing its length or timing, so every metric is meaningful against the original.
_efficiency: What the run cost in time and memory, kept apart from the metrics block above. Those describe the watermarking method and reproduce from a seed; these describe this machine on this day and do not. enabled: false means none of it is measured. Metrics - embed_latency, detect_latency, attack_latency (seconds), container_footprint (MiB).
_efficiency_caveat: A native attack is timed as pure computation; one running in Docker includes base64 encoding of the audio and the HTTP round trip, so the two are not comparable. The first call to a cold container also pays for loading the model.

metrics._container_footprint: Resident memory of the model's container while warm, in MiB, read once per run via the docker CLI. It is the WHOLE service - weights, Python runtime, web server - not the size of the model, and the services load their weights at start so a container can never be measured empty. Absent, and simply omitted, when docker is unavailable or no container publishes the model's port.

_duration_groups: Report separately per audio length. boundaries: ascending seconds, e.g. [5, 10, 20, 30] gives <5s, 5-10s, 10-20s, 20-30s, >30s; an empty list disables grouping. include_overall adds a final all-files section.
